profile.headline: Builder
profile.summary:
I am a professional software engineer with focus on building scalable and flexible software. I enjoy designing and implementing flexible and robust software. I also enjoy developing APIs. I don't have any  programming language/technology constraints. I enjoy learning  and applying new technologies.

Specialties: Object Oriented Development,Java, Python, PHP, C++,  API Design/Development,MySQL,memcached,nginx,apache,cherrypy,C, REST APIs,ETL, Django

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently driving digital transformation across multiple high-impact domains — from modernizing legacy infrastructure through cloud migration, to optimizing payments systems, to now leading the organization's Generative AI initiatives. Focused on building scalable, future-ready solutions that sit at the intersection of emerging technology and real business value.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
● Responsible for architecture, design & implementation of EMR Studio, a managed IDE for data
scientists and data engineers.
● Designed and Implemented EMR Studio features using Java, Go, Python, AWS Lambda,
AWS Step functions, AWS SQS and DynamoDB.
● Responsible for entire development life cycle, including requirements gathering, architecture
& design, security reviews, implementation, testing and deployments.
● Involved in design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring junior engineers.
● Responsible for monitoring service metrics and responding to incidents to ensure smooth
operations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer & Team Lead
positions.description:
Ayasdi provides a machine learning (supervised & unsupervised) platform based on topological data analysis. Our algorithms requires random access over big data (~10k columns). As a senior member of the Infrastructure team, my duty involves creating a platform that scales to process such wide datasets along with providing decent performance. I help the team with prioritization, technical guidance, troubleshooting cloud & on-premise deployments. 

● Designed and Implemented critical infrastructure for Ayasdi to make the platform more performant and scalable using Java, PostgreSql, Apache Spark, Hadoop, & Yarn.
● Designed and Implemented secure Jupyter notebooks allowing users to access our platform seamlessly using just the web browser, using Java and Docker for containerization.
● Designed and Implemented Asynchronous notifications system allowing better user experience for our end users and reducing the load on our servers.
● Introduced Apache Spark to existing infrastructure to scale our platform to process terabytes of data.
● Designed and Implemented a framework/infrastructure where users are able to quickly write, execute & deploy python applications on our cluster leveraging the resources and capabilities of the entire cluster. This allowed development of two brand applications, powered by Ayasdi platform, in less than 6 months. 
● Involved in troubleshooting and supporting the on premise installations for our customers. 
Involved in code reviews, deployments, guiding junior engineers, identifying and fixing production issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Server Side Lead
positions.description:
here at QuickPay we want to disrupt the parking industry. We want to remove pain and hassle people face for Parking in their daily lives. QuickPay's unique platform allows users to easily park in all possible environments which covers on-street, off-street parking including gated garages. we allow users to pay for parking via mobile apps, text and voice.  

it's fun to work with a small but very passionate team who love what they are doing. My role includes design and development of server side APIs and sub-systems like Parking, Payments, Pricing, various third party integrations and many more. 

●  Responsible for Design and Development of server side products/features. 

● Designed and Implemented REST APIs consumed by client apps (mobile and server side clients) using PHP, MySQL, and various AWS services like SQS, SNS, S3 etc.

● Designed and Implemented Rate Engine which can handle almost any types of rate configuration available in today's parking facilities.

● Designed and Implemented a small and easy to extend DSL using php Ruler (https://github.com/bobthecow/Ruler) for specifying various kinds of discounts based on various user and location attributes like email address, number of parking session, space number etc. 

●  Responsible for requirement gathering, design and Implementation of products/features. 

●  Responsible for Deployments and Debugging production issues. 

●  Responsible for managing Junior Engineers. 

●  Currently working on Integrating LPR (License Plate Recognition System) by developing APIs and Client Libraries using PHP and C for seamless parking experience.

● Maintaining QP’s pay-by-text and pay-by-voice client applications developed using Node.js, mongodb, voxeo and Twilio APIs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Engineering
positions.description:
● Migrated  Appcelerator’s analytics MySQL database to Vertica , an in-memory, column oriented database built for advanced analytics. (http://www.vertica.com)

● Scaled Appcelerator’s analytics service using Vertica database cluster to analyze, process
and serve millions of daily transactions.

● Involved in Design and Development of software and APIs using Java, PHP, Ruby, Javascript, Node.js and high performance Message Queues like RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: ● Built REST apis for Kaboodle's mobile application using Jersey and Spring

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented various features on the site using Java-Spring,  IBATIS, and MySQL

● Implemented a system for product keyword generation using Hadoop, Hive and Python

● Designed and Implemented Follow metaphor for the Kaboodle

● Worked on setting up MySQL replication for production database servers

● Wrote a tool for parsing Kaboodle’s logs for various kinds of errors which sends an email about various kinds of errors and exceptions occur on the site

● Worked on writing a tool for catching redirection spam which was affecting Kaboodle’s affiliate revenue

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented Service Oriented Architecture using MVC pattern and
REST APIs.

● Analyzed various kinds of caching schemes and implemented
memcache for PlayList’s data model and controller layers.

● Implemented PlayList’s content management component using
python, MySQL, cherrypy – python http server.

● Wrote unit tests for Playlist’s data model layer.

● Developed ETL process for ingesting itunes data feed.

● Implemented processes to process Itunes’ huge data feeds using
Hadoop – a map/reduce framework.

● Implemented an ETL process using python, MySQL to download
and process data (in XML) from SonyBMG.

● Developed and Improved PlayList’s ETL algorithms in order to
produce highly normalized and clean data.

● Implemented audio fingerprinting service using an open source
library - libfooid, C and Java

● Developed Hadoop map reduce jobs to process apache/nginx logs for various kinds of data analytics requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
● Designed, Implemented and Unit Testd SideStep’s Hotel Review and
Virtual Tour system using Java, Python, MySQL and Oracle.

● Designed data driveen Test cases for SideStep’s content service.

● Implemented unit Test cases using JUnit, Python unittest
frameworks.

● Wrote Design Documents of the projects I worked on.

● Presented my projects to Engineering team.

● Actively participated in company’s daily scrum meetings to resolve
problems.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Developed online tutorials on library services and quizzes for library
patrons and students of University using PHP, HTML, JavaScript
and MySQL.
